selected_approach.reason: This path directly fixes unsafe prototype behavior while preserving the repository layout and producing the explicit v3 governance artifacts requested in the TXT.

change_atomicity.description: A single foundation-hardening pass over the existing harness prototype. The files are grouped because the unsafe Layer 3 loop, missing access policy, weak sanitizer, and accuracy-first evaluator are mutually dependent safety defects in the same harness boundary.
change_atomicity.future_split_recommendation: In a real PR queue, split follow-up work into policy, evaluator metrics, meta-harness proposal UX, and CI hardening PRs after this foundation lands.

implementation_order: Add access policy and trace logging primitives.
Upgrade sanitizer to recursive fail-closed checks and audit-friendly category reporting.
Update Layer 1 modules to sanitize LLM-bound payloads and write raw traces without requiring external LLM credentials for tests.
Update Layer 2 golden record schema and evaluator metrics to recall-first behavior.
Add deployment gate logic outside Layer 3 mutable scope.
Replace direct Layer 3 code overwrite behavior with proposal-only scope validation.
Update skill and architecture docs with v3 matrix, reward-hacking scenarios, Phase 3 checklist, Phase 1 MVP, Triad exemptions, CI rules, anti-patterns, and atomic checks.
Strengthen Triad verification script and add CI workflow.
Run local smoke tests and Triad validation.

predicted_behavior.clean_patent_input: Retriever reads an allowed mock patent, sanitizer passes it, and a trace event is written under meta_harness_workspace/experience/<run_id>/<patent_id>/retriever/.
predicted_behavior.restricted_payload_input: Any email, Korean resident registration number, passport-like number, card number, account-like financial number, phone number, or medical-record marker raises DataProtectionViolation before LLM or trace persistence.
predicted_behavior.golden_set_evaluation: EvalRunner reads golden records through Layer 2 access policy, runs the production pipeline, computes recall, precision, critical misses, per-category recall, and ECE, and writes raw evaluator traces.
predicted_behavior.layer3_proposal: MetaHarnessAgent reads an eval report and writes or returns a proposal, but rejects protected paths, sanitizer changes, evaluator metric changes, golden set files, and deployment gate changes as immutable scope violations.
predicted_behavior.gate_regression: DeploymentGate rejects candidates with lower recall, more critical misses, per-category regressions beyond threshold, worse ECE, data protection violations, or insufficient Pareto behavior.

unit_tests: Sanitizer blocks PII/financial examples and passes domain patent text.
Access policy denies all PII/financial access and denies Layer 3 immutable mutations.
Deployment gate accepts non-regressive Pareto candidates and rejects critical miss increases.
Triad verifier rejects fake-diverse incubation and multi-atomic plans.
integration_tests: Run retriever, parser, analyzer, curator, orchestrator, and evaluator smoke tests from enzyme-patent-harness.
Run MetaHarnessAgent proposal smoke path without allowing direct code overwrite.
validation_plan.lightweight_smoke_test: python scripts/verify_triad.py feature-v3-harness-hardening followed by the local test scripts.

rollback_plan.trigger: Any smoke test fails due to the new policy/metric primitives, or existing clean patent retrieval and parser behavior no longer works.
rollback_plan.procedure: Revert the files listed in change_scope for this task, leaving prior build_log directories and golden set data untouched.

risk_assessment.rule_0_data_protection_impact: Positive; recursive sanitizer and access control make fail-closed behavior explicit before LLM calls and trace writes.
risk_assessment.immutable_area_invasion_risk: Controlled; code blocks Layer 3 proposals touching protected metrics, golden set, sanitizer, evaluator metrics, deployment gate, or test-set paths.
risk_assessment.producer_reviewer_separation_risk: Controlled; Layer 1 writes model outputs and traces, Layer 2 reads golden set and production output, Layer 3 proposes only.
risk_assessment.one_way_layer_flow_risk: Controlled in code-level policy; OS-level read-only mounts remain a Phase 3 infrastructure task.
risk_assessment.layer3_reward_hacking_risk: Reduced by proposal-only behavior, immutable path validation, and an external deployment gate.
risk_assessment.remaining_risk: Local filesystem permissions are not true read-only mounts; the document marks this as a Phase 3 checklist item.

human_review_required: Approve final category floors and ECE thresholds before real patent deployment.
Review the skill file and protected metric definitions before any Layer 3 run is enabled.
Approve CI exemption labels and the list of Triad-exempt task types.
